feed.subtitle: ISAE-SUPAERO aerospace engineering student specializing in Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC), Control Systems, and Space Mission Analysis. Bridging control theory with hands-on systems engineering, I focus on the practical modeling, simulation, and implementation of complex orbital missions. My ambition is to contribute to next-generation space programmes as a Mission Analysis or GNC Engineer for space systems.

entry.title: Welcome to my portfolio
entry.content:
Welcome! This site gathers my work in Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC), control systems and space mission analysis, together with the robotics and software projects I build on the side.

You can browse my projects, read my CV, or contact me through the links on the home page.

I plan to use this blog to write about the things I learn: spacecraft dynamics and control, rendezvous and proximity operations, space robotics, and life as an analog astronaut.
